definitions.explanation: A raised platform where performances take place.
The location where events take place, including in stories or films.

notes:
USAGE: {舞台|ぶたい} refers both to physical theater stages and to settings/scenes where action takes place.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand on stage, to perform)
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to set [a story] in)
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (backstage, behind the scenes)
- ⟦{表|おもて}{舞台|ぶたい}→表舞台：20605_omotebutai⟧ (public stage, limelight)

COMPOUNDS:
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧ (stage actor)
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧ (stage set)
- {舞台|ぶたい}⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧ (stage costume)
